title: π0.5: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization

tldr.en: Co-train on heterogeneous robotic and semantic tasks for open-world generalization; use as policy context for acceleration studies.
tldr.zh: 以异构机器人与语义任务联合训练，提升开放世界泛化；作为加速研究的策略背景收录。

evaluation_scope.en: Real-world long-horizon manipulation; foundation reference, not a dedicated inference-acceleration method. Local checkpoint/version must be recorded separately.
evaluation_scope.zh: 真实世界长时序操作；属于基础模型文献，不是专门推理加速方法。本地 checkpoint 与实现版本需要另记。
